# unity-dialogue-system

> Run branching game dialogues from JSON graphs with typed variables, a bounded condition language, assignment nodes and localized lines with locale fallback NuGet package `Trysac.UnityDialogueSystem`, namespace `Trysac.UnityDialogueSystem`, MIT
> licensed, .NET >= 10, base class library only.

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions, limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the library and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
